On Day 1, Gemma claimed Officer and named Haiku as her shown killer, but Haiku kept demanding proof instead of answering. The table voted Gemma out 4 to 3, which was the big mistake, because she was the real Officer. Night 2 took Opus, and on Day 2 Terra stayed on Haiku, whose last words tried to pin Terra and Luna, so Haiku went out 3 to 2. On Day 3 Sol kept leaning on Terra after a protected Night 3, and Sol was voted out 3 to 1, so the town won with every killer gone.
